gen-fs-karma-rubik: Comfortable and refined, Karma leads with rounded tall lowercase and a restrained swell in its curves. And Rubik, a soft sans-serif with big, open lowercase, gives that polish a friendlier voice.
gen-fs-khand-fs-gambetta: Khand draws crisp, tightly spaced letters with a ballpoint's plain line weight. Where it stays flat and direct, the text serif Gambetta adds a subtle pen-like swing in its bowls and wide channels into each counter.
gen-fs-khand-newsreader: Khand sets tight, crisp letters with no thick or thin strokes anywhere, even in its w, over a refined serif body. Newsreader supplies the mid-level contrast.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-archivo: Kohinoor Zerone draws round letters like bent wire, in one constant pen-like line. Archivo then takes over with a sans-serif body whose curves open outward and whose tall x-height gives the page a sturdy, editorial footing.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-fs-roundo: Small counters stay unclogged in Roundo, a geometric plain sans whose n has arch and stem matching, which suits brief copy. Yet Kohinoor Zerone is the one for display, drawing round letters like bent wire.
gen-fs-kola-archivo: Kola brings a bold, distinctive display face with moderate lowercase height and a plain build. Archivo follows with taller lowercase and outward-opening curves, and that editorial height is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-fs-kola-fs-chillax: Kola stands out as bold, plain display type with low contrast. Chillax, a relaxed plain sans with spaghetti-like lines and unfinished loops, is good for a handful of lines, so give it a size that lets those curves breathe.
gen-fs-kola-fs-literata: Bold and plain up top, scholarly below, with a clear turn between the two. Kola holds the display work with its low-contrast shapes, while Literata, a classic serif, handles the text with sturdy thin lines and wide mouths.
gen-fs-kola-fs-neco: Kola's plainness is the first thing you see, a bold display face with low contrast throughout. But Neco, a dignified classic serif with hairlines only slightly lighter than its stems, is comfortable in small doses.
gen-fs-kola-fs-ranade: Bold and distinctive, Kola sets a plain display tone at moderate lowercase height before Ranade, a plain sans with taller lowercase, takes over. Its widely spaced, organic line gives the text room.
